  .mv { font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .mv.pos { color:var(--green); } .mv.neg { color:var(--red); } .mv.flat { color:var(--fg-3); }

<h2 style="font-size:14px;color:var(--fg-3);letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;margin:26px 0 12px">Crisis lens — the detector composite</h2>

<script src="/tenor-signals.js" defer></script>

<script>
(function () {
  const FEED = "https://justhodl-data-proxy.raafouis.workers.dev/data/auction-desk.json";
  const FEED_S3 = "https://justhodl-dashboard-live.s3.amazonaws.com/data/auction-desk.json";
  const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
  const esc = s => String(s == null ? "" : s).replace(/&/g, "&amp;").replace(/</g, "&lt;").replace(/>/g, "&gt;").replace(/"/g, "&quot;");
  const bn = x => x == null ? "—" : (Math.abs(x) >= 1e9 ? "$" + (x / 1e9).toFixed(x >= 1e11 ? 0 : 1) + "B" : "$" + (x / 1e6).toFixed(0) + "M");
  const pct = (x, d = 0) => x == null ? "—" : x.toFixed(d) + "%";
  const num = (x, d = 2) => x == null ? "—" : Number(x).toFixed(d);
  const zs = z => z == null ? "" : (z > 0 ? "+" : "") + z.toFixed(1) + "σ";
  const toneOf = t => t === "bullish" ? "bull" : t === "bearish" ? "bear" : (t === "mixed" || t === "cautious") ? "warn" : "";
  const tagClass = t => /BULLISH|EASY|STRONG|MAX FILL|INJECTION/.test(t) ? "bull" : /WEAK|TAIL|BEARISH|OFF/.test(t) ? "bear" : /MIXED|LARGE|HEAVY|WATCH/.test(t) ? "warn" : "";
  const ago = iso => { if (!iso) return ""; const m = Math.round((Date.now() - Date.parse(iso)) / 60000); return m < 60 ? m + "m ago" : m < 2880 ? Math.round(m / 60) + "h ago" : Math.round(m / 1440) + "d ago"; };
  const fmtDate = d => d ? new Date(d + "T12:00:00Z").toLocaleDateString(undefined, { weekday: "short", month: "short", day: "numeric" }) : "—";

  function renderBanner(D) {
    const v = D.today && D.today.verdict;
    const b = $("desk-banner");
    const stamp = Date.parse(D.generated_at);
    if (!v || !Number.isFinite(stamp) || stamp > Date.now()+300000 || Date.now()-stamp > 48*3600000) {
      b.className = "desk-banner";
      $("desk-headline").textContent = "Current desk assessment unavailable. Dated observations below are an archived snapshot.";
      $("desk-fresh").textContent = D.generated_at ? "Snapshot generated " + D.generated_at : "Publication time unavailable";
      for (const id of ["desk-tags","desk-implications","desk-bullets","desk-ai"]) $(id).innerHTML = "";
      $("desk-ai").hidden = true;
      return;
    }
    b.className = "desk-banner " + (v.risk_assets === "bullish" ? "bullish" : v.risk_assets === "bearish" ? "bearish" : v.risk_assets === "mixed" ? "mixed" : "");
    $("desk-fresh").textContent = `${fmtDate(v.date)} · engine ran ${ago(D.generated_at)} · newest auction ${D.freshness.newest_auction || "—"} · newest buyback ${D.freshness.newest_buyback || "—"}`;
    $("desk-headline").textContent = v.headline;
    $("desk-tags").innerHTML = (v.tags || []).map(t => `<span class="desk-tag ${tagClass(t)}">${esc(t)}</span>`).join("");
    const liq = v.liquidity, rates = v.rates, risk = v.risk_assets;
    $("desk-implications").innerHTML = [
      ["Treasury cash context", liq === "cash_management_context" ? "Buyback accepted par observed; settlement and financing offsets require separate measurement" : "Net liquidity effect not established", ""],
      ["Rates", rates, /well bid/.test(rates) ? "bull" : /concession/.test(rates) ? "bear" : ""],
      ["Decision eligibility", "Measurement only — participation and buyback fill do not authorize a trade or position size", ""],
    ].map(([l, val, cls]) => `<div class="desk-imp ${cls}"><div class="l">${l}</div><div class="v">${esc(val)}</div></div>`).join("");
    $("desk-bullets").innerHTML = (v.bullets || []).map(x => `<li>${esc(x)}</li>`).join("");
    const ai = D.today.ai_note;
    $("desk-ai").hidden = true;
    if (ai && ai.what_happened) {
      $("desk-ai").hidden = false;
      $("desk-ai").innerHTML = [["What happened", ai.what_happened], ["What it means", ai.what_it_means], ["Watch next", ai.watch_next]]
        .map(([h, p]) => `<div><h4>${h}</h4><p>${esc(p)}</p></div>`).join("") + `<div style="grid-column:1/-1;font-size:10px;color:var(--fg-4)">Desk explanation: ${esc(ai.generation_method === "deterministic_treasury_v1" ? "deterministic facts; no paid AI" : ai.model || "legacy explanation")} · ${ago(ai.generated_at)}</div>`;
    }
  }

  function takeBar(a) {
    const i = a.indirect_pct || 0, d = a.direct_pct || 0, p = a.pd_pct || 0;
    return `<div class="op-take"><span class="ind" style="width:${i}%"></span><span class="dir" style="width:${d}%"></span><span class="pd" style="width:${p}%"></span></div>
      <div class="op-take-l"><span>indirect <b>${pct(a.indirect_pct)}</b></span><span>direct <b>${pct(a.direct_pct)}</b></span><span>dealers <b>${pct(a.pd_pct)}</b></span>${a.soma ? `<span>SOMA <b>${bn(a.soma)}</b></span>` : ""}</div>`;
  }

  function auctionCard(a, imp) {
    const z = a.z || {}, t = a.trailing12 || {};
    const zc = v => v == null ? "" : v > 0 ? "pos" : v < 0 ? "neg" : "";
    const tone = imp ? toneOf(imp.tone) : "";
    return `<div class="op-card ${tone}">
      <div class="op-head"><span class="t">${esc(a.term)} ${esc(a.instrument_kind === "TIPS" ? "TIPS" : a.instrument_kind === "FRN" ? "FRN" : a.type)}${a.reopening ? " (reopen)" : ""}</span><span class="s">${bn(a.total_accepted)} accepted · CUSIP ${esc(a.cusip)}</span><button class="op-grade ${a.grade}" type="button" data-gx="${esc(a.cusip)}|${esc(a.auction_date)}" title="Why this grade? Click to see how it was scored">${esc(a.grade)}</button></div>
      <div class="op-metrics">
        <div class="op-m"><div class="l" title="${a.type === "Bill" ? METRIC_HELP["High inv. rate"] : METRIC_HELP["High yield"]}">High ${a.type === "Bill" ? "inv. rate" : a.instrument_kind === "TIPS" ? "real yield" : a.instrument_kind === "FRN" ? "discount margin" : "yield"}</div><div class="v">${num(a.instrument_kind === "FRN" ? a.high_discount_margin : a.high_yield, 3)}%</div><div class="z">${esc(a.quote_basis || "Quote basis unverified")}${a.high_discount_rate != null ? " · disc " + num(a.high_discount_rate, 3) + "%" : ""}</div></div>
        <div class="op-m"><div class="l" title="${METRIC_HELP["Prior-close gap"]}">Prior-close gap</div><div class="v">${a.tail_bp == null ? "—" : (a.tail_bp > 0 ? "+" : "") + a.tail_bp.toFixed(1) + "bp"}</div><div class="z">${esc(a.tail_missing_reason || "Context only; excluded from score")}</div></div>
        <div class="op-m"><div class="l" title="${METRIC_HELP["Bid-to-cover"]}">Bid-to-cover</div><div class="v">${num(a.btc)}</div><div class="z ${zc(z.btc)}">${z.btc == null ? "" : "z " + zs(z.btc)} ${t.btc != null ? "· avg " + t.btc.toFixed(2) : ""}</div></div>
        <div class="op-m"><div class="l" title="${METRIC_HELP["Allotted at high"]}">Allotted at high</div><div class="v">${pct(a.allocation_pct, 1)}</div><div class="z ${zc(-(z.allocation || 0))}">${z.allocation == null ? "" : "z " + zs(z.allocation)}</div></div>
      </div>
      ${takeBar(a)}
      <div class="op-verdict">${esc(a.verdict)}</div>
      ${imp ? `<div class="op-imp">Rates: <b class="${toneOf(imp.tone)}">${esc(imp.rates)}</b> · Risk assets: <b class="${toneOf(imp.tone)}">${esc(imp.risk)}</b></div>` : ""}
      ${(a.explain || []).length ? `<details class="op-plain" open><summary>In plain English</summary><ul>${a.explain.map(l => `<li><b>${esc(l.metric)}</b> — ${esc(l.text)}</li>`).join("")}</ul></details>` : ""}
    </div>`;
  }

  const METRIC_HELP = {
    "High inv. rate": "Annualised yield the last accepted bidder received (bills quote a discount rate; the investment rate is the comparable yield).",
    "High yield": "The single yield every accepted bidder is filled at.",
    "Prior-close gap": "Auction yield minus the prior-close nominal par curve. Includes market movement and security differences; not a when-issued tail. TIPS, FRNs and unverified instruments have no nominal comparison. Excluded from the participation score.",
    "Bid-to-cover": "Dollars bid for every dollar sold. Higher = more demand.",
    "Allotted at high": "Proration of bids at the stop: the share of bids at the highest accepted yield that was allotted. This is not the fraction of the whole auction sold and does not establish an auction failure.",
  };

  function buybackCard(b) {
    const secs = (b.securities || []).slice(0, 40);
    return `<div class="op-card buyback ${toneOf(b.implication && b.implication.tone)}">
      <div class="op-head"><span class="t">Treasury buyback</span><span class="s">${esc(b.maturity_bucket || "")} · ${esc(b.operation_type || "")} · settles ${esc(b.settlement_date || "")}</span></div>
      <div class="desk-tags">${(b.tags || []).map(t => `<span class="desk-tag ${tagClass(t)}">${esc(t)}</span>`).join("")}</div>
      <div class="op-metrics">
        <div class="op-m"><div class="l">Maximum</div><div class="v">${bn(b.max_par)}</div></div>
        <div class="op-m"><div class="l">Offered</div><div class="v">${bn(b.offered)}</div><div class="z">${b.coverage != null ? b.coverage.toFixed(2) + "x accepted" : ""}</div></div>
        <div class="op-m"><div class="l">Accepted</div><div class="v">${bn(b.accepted)}</div><div class="z">${b.fill_pct != null ? b.fill_pct.toFixed(0) + "% of max" : ""}</div></div>
        <div class="op-m"><div class="l">Size rank</div><div class="v">${b.size_pctile == null ? "—" : "p" + b.size_pctile}</div><div class="z">${b.n_issues_accepted != null ? b.n_issues_accepted + " CUSIPs" : ""}</div></div>
      </div>
      <div class="op-verdict">${esc(b.verdict)}</div>
      ${b.implication ? `<div class="op-imp">Liquidity: <b class="${toneOf(b.implication.tone)}">${esc(b.implication.liquidity)}</b> · Rates: <b>${esc(b.implication.rates)}</b> · Risk assets: <b class="${toneOf(b.implication.tone)}">${esc(b.implication.risk)}</b></div>` : ""}
      ${secs.length ? `<details class="op-secs"><summary>${secs.length} securities bought — sorted by time left to maturity</summary><table style="margin-top:6px"><thead><tr><th>CUSIP</th><th>Left to maturity</th><th>Original</th><th class="r">Coupon</th><th>Matures</th><th class="r">Par accepted</th><th class="r">Avg price</th></tr></thead><tbody>${secs.map(s => `<tr><td>${esc(s.cusip)}</td><td class="tk">${esc(s.ttm_label || "—")}</td><td>${esc(s.orig_term || "—")}</td><td class="r">${num(s.coupon, 3)}</td><td>${esc(s.maturity)}</td><td class="r">${bn(s.par_accepted)}</td><td class="r">${num(s.price, 3)}</td></tr>`).join("")}</tbody></table></details>` : ""}
    </div>`;
  }

  function renderOps(D) {
    const T = D.today || {};
    const imps = T.implications || {};
    const html = (T.buybacks || []).map(buybackCard).join("") + (T.auctions || []).map(a => auctionCard(a, imps[a.cusip])).join("");
    $("desk-ops").innerHTML = html || `<div style="color:var(--fg-3)">No operations on ${esc(T.date || "the latest day")}.</div>`;
    $("desk-ops-meta").textContent = `${(T.auctions || []).length} auction${(T.auctions || []).length === 1 ? "" : "s"} · ${(T.buybacks || []).length} buyback${(T.buybacks || []).length === 1 ? "" : "s"} · ${fmtDate(T.date)}`;
  }

  function renderBuybacks(D) {
    const B = D.buybacks || {}, P = B.program || {}, ops = (B.operations || []).slice();
    $("bb-stats").innerHTML = [
      ["Program total", bn(P.total_accepted), `${P.n_ops || 0} ops since ${P.since || "—"}`],
      ["This fiscal year", bn(P.fy_accepted), `from ${P.fy_start || "—"}`],
      ["Last 4 weeks", bn(P.last_4w_accepted), "accepted par"],
      ["Average fill", pct(P.avg_fill_pct, 0), "accepted / maximum"],
    ].map(([l, v, n]) => `<div class="desk-stat"><div class="l">${l}</div><div class="v">${v}</div><div class="n">${esc(n)}</div></div>`).join("");
    const rows = ops.filter(o => o.accepted != null).sort((a, b) => a.operation_date < b.operation_date ? -1 : 1).slice(-40);
    const svg = $("bb-chart");
    if (rows.length) {
      const W = 720, H = 190, padL = 44, padR = 44, padT = 12, padB = 26;
      const maxAcc = Math.max(...rows.map(r => r.accepted)) || 1;
      let cum = 0; const cums = rows.map(r => (cum += r.accepted));
      const maxCum = cums[cums.length - 1] || 1;
      const bw = (W - padL - padR) / rows.length;
      const y1 = v => padT + (H - padT - padB) * (1 - v / maxAcc);
      const y2 = v => padT + (H - padT - padB) * (1 - v / maxCum);
      const bars = rows.map((r, i) => `<rect x="${(padL + i * bw + 1).toFixed(1)}" y="${y1(r.accepted).toFixed(1)}" width="${Math.max(2, bw - 2).toFixed(1)}" height="${(H - padB - y1(r.accepted)).toFixed(1)}" fill="${r.liquidity_signal === "strong" ? "#22c55e" : "#a78bfa"}" opacity="${i === rows.length - 1 ? 1 : .75}"><title>${r.operation_date} ${esc(r.maturity_bucket || "")}: ${bn(r.accepted)} of ${bn(r.max_par)} (${r.fill_pct != null ? r.fill_pct.toFixed(0) : "—"}% fill)</title></rect>`).join("");
      const line = cums.map((c, i) => `${i ? "L" : "M"}${(padL + i * bw + bw / 2).toFixed(1)},${y2(c).toFixed(1)}`).join(" ");
      const ticks = [0, .5, 1].map(f => `<text x="${padL - 6}" y="${(y1(f * maxAcc) + 4).toFixed(1)}" font-size="9" fill="#6b7a92" text-anchor="end">${bn(f * maxAcc)}</text>`).join("")
        + [0, .5, 1].map(f => `<text x="${W - padR + 6}" y="${(y2(f * maxCum) + 4).toFixed(1)}" font-size="9" fill="#a78bfa">${bn(f * maxCum)}</text>`).join("");
      const xl = [0, Math.floor(rows.length / 2), rows.length - 1].map(i => `<text x="${(padL + i * bw + bw / 2).toFixed(1)}" y="${H - 8}" font-size="9" fill="#6b7a92" text-anchor="middle">${rows[i].operation_date}</text>`).join("");
      svg.innerHTML = `<line x1="${padL}" y1="${H - padB}" x2="${W - padR}" y2="${H - padB}" stroke="rgba(120,145,180,.3)"/>${bars}<path d="${line}" fill="none" stroke="#a78bfa" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="3 3"/>${ticks}${xl}<text x="${padL}" y="${padT}" font-size="9" fill="#6b7a92">accepted par per operation (bars) · program cumulative (dashed)</text>`;
    }
    $("bb-table").innerHTML = ops.slice(0, 14).map(o => `<tr><td class="tk">${esc(o.operation_date)}</td><td>${esc(o.maturity_bucket || "—")}</td><td>${esc(o.operation_type || "—")}</td><td class="r">${bn(o.max_par)}</td><td class="r">${bn(o.offered)}</td><td class="r"><b>${bn(o.accepted)}</b></td><td class="r">${pct(o.fill_pct, 0)}</td><td class="r">${o.coverage != null ? o.coverage.toFixed(2) + "x" : "—"}</td><td>${(o.tags || []).filter(t => /EASY|INJECTION|MAX/.test(t)).map(t => `<span class="pill" style="background:var(--green-soft);color:var(--green);margin-right:4px">${esc(t)}</span>`).join("") || "<span class=\"flat\">routine</span>"}</td></tr>`).join("") || `<tr><td colspan="9" class="flat">No buyback operations in the feed.</td></tr>`;
  }

  function securityLabel(a) {
    return a.instrument_kind === "TIPS" ? "TIPS" : a.instrument_kind === "FRN" ? "FRN" : a.type || "Unverified";
  }

  function renderCalendar(D) {
    const C = D.calendar || {};
    const rows = (C.auctions || []).map(a => `<tr class="cal-row"><td class="tk">${fmtDate(a.auction_date)}</td><td>${esc(a.term)} ${esc(securityLabel(a))}${a.reopening ? '<span class="rx">REOPEN</span>' : ""}</td><td class="r">${bn(a.offering)}</td><td>${esc(a.issue_date || "")}</td></tr>`);
    (C.buybacks || []).forEach(b => rows.push(`<tr class="cal-row"><td class="tk">${fmtDate(b.operation_date)}</td><td>Buyback · ${esc(b.maturity_bucket || "")}</td><td class="r">${bn(b.max_par)}</td><td>${esc(b.settlement_date || "")}</td></tr>`));
    $("cal-table").innerHTML = rows.join("") || `<tr><td colspan="4" class="flat">Nothing announced yet.</td></tr>`;
    if(typeof window.renderTriggers==='function') window.renderTriggers(D);
  }

  function renderDays(D) {
    $("days-table").innerHTML = (D.recent_days || []).slice(0, 15).map(v => `<tr><td class="tk">${fmtDate(v.date)}</td><td style="white-space:normal;min-width:260px">${esc(v.headline)}</td><td>${(v.tags || []).map(t => `<span class="pill desk-tag ${tagClass(t)}" style="margin:1px 3px 1px 0">${esc(t)}</span>`).join("")}</td><td class="r">${v.n_auctions}</td><td class="r">${v.buyback_accepted ? bn(v.buyback_accepted) : "—"}</td><td class="${v.risk_assets === "bullish" ? "pos" : v.risk_assets === "bearish" ? "neg" : "flat"}"><span class="${v.risk_assets === "bullish" ? "pos" : v.risk_assets === "bearish" ? "neg" : "flat"}">${esc(v.risk_assets)}</span></td></tr>`).join("");
  }

  let tapeFilter = "All";
  function renderTape(D) {
    const all = D.auctions || [];
    const types = ["All", ...new Set(all.map(a => securityLabel(a)))];
    $("tape-filters").innerHTML = types.map(t => `<button class="${t === tapeFilter ? "active" : ""}" data-t="${esc(t)}">${esc(t)}</button>`).join("");
    $("tape-filters").querySelectorAll("button").forEach(b => b.addEventListener("click", () => { tapeFilter = b.dataset.t; renderTape(D); wireExplainer(D); }));
    const rows = all.filter(a => tapeFilter === "All" || securityLabel(a) === tapeFilter).slice(0, 80);
    $("tape-meta").textContent = `${all.length} auctions in the bank window · ${D.freshness.bank_records || 0} records banked`;
    $("desk-tape").innerHTML = rows.map(a => `<tr><td class="tk">${esc(a.auction_date)}</td><td>${esc(a.term)} ${esc(securityLabel(a))}${a.reopening ? '<span class="rx" style="color:var(--purple);font-size:9px;margin-left:5px">R</span>' : ""}</td><td class="r">${bn(a.total_accepted)}</td><td class="r">${num(a.instrument_kind === "FRN" ? a.high_discount_margin : a.high_yield, 3)}</td><td class="r"><span class="flat">${a.tail_bp == null ? "—" : (a.tail_bp > 0 ? "+" : "") + a.tail_bp.toFixed(1)}</span></td><td class="r">${num(a.btc)}</td><td class="r"><span class="${(a.z && a.z.btc) > 0.5 ? "pos" : (a.z && a.z.btc) < -0.5 ? "neg" : "flat"}">${a.z && a.z.btc != null ? zs(a.z.btc) : "—"}</span></td><td class="r">${pct(a.indirect_pct)}</td><td class="r">${pct(a.pd_pct)}</td><td class="r">${pct(a.direct_pct)}</td><td class="r">${pct(a.allocation_pct, 1)}</td><td class="r"><button class="grade-pill ${a.grade}" type="button" data-gx="${esc(a.cusip)}|${esc(a.auction_date)}" title="Why this grade? Click for the breakdown">${esc(a.grade)}</button></td></tr>`).join("");
  }

  function renderTenors(D) {
    const T = D.chart_cohort_contract === "treasury-comparable-chart.v1" ? D.chart_cohorts || {} : {};
    const order = Object.keys(T).sort((a, b) => T[b].length - T[a].length).slice(0, 8);
    $("tenor-grid").innerHTML = order.map(k => {
      const pts = T[k].slice(0, 24).reverse().filter(p => typeof p.btc === 'number' && Number.isFinite(p.btc));
      if (!pts.length) return "";
      const W = 260, H = 64, min = Math.min(...pts.map(p => p.btc)) * .97, max = Math.max(...pts.map(p => p.btc)) * 1.03;
      const x = i => 4 + i * (W - 8) / Math.max(pts.length - 1, 1), y = v => H - 4 - (H - 10) * (v - min) / Math.max(max - min, 1e-6);
      const path = pts.map((p, i) => `${i ? "L" : "M"}${x(i).toFixed(1)},${y(p.btc).toFixed(1)}`).join(" ");
      const avg = pts.slice(-12).reduce((s, p) => s + p.btc, 0) / Math.min(12, pts.length);
      const last = pts[pts.length - 1];
      return `<div class="tenor-card"><div class="t">${esc(k)}<span>last ${last.btc.toFixed(2)} · ${Math.min(12,pts.length)}-point mean ${avg.toFixed(2)} · <b class="grade-pill ${esc(last.grade)}">${esc(last.grade)}</b></span></div>
        <svg viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${H}" preserveAspectRatio="none"><line x1="4" y1="${y(avg).toFixed(1)}" x2="${W - 4}" y2="${y(avg).toFixed(1)}" stroke="#6b7a92" stroke-dasharray="3 3"/><path d="${path}" fill="none" stroke="#06b6d4" stroke-width="1.6"/>${pts.map((p, i) => `<circle cx="${x(i).toFixed(1)}" cy="${y(p.btc).toFixed(1)}" r="1.8" fill="${p.grade === "A" || p.grade === "B" ? "#22c55e" : p.grade === "D" || p.grade === "F" ? "#ef4444" : "#6b7a92"}"><title>${p.d} · BTC ${p.btc.toFixed(2)} · grade ${p.grade}${p.prior_close_concession_bp != null ? " · prior-close context " + p.prior_close_concession_bp.toFixed(1) + "bp" : ""}</title></circle>`).join("")}</svg></div>`;
    }).join("");
    const m = D.methodology || {};
    $("desk-method").innerHTML = `<b>How the grades are made.</b> ${esc(m.z_scores || "")}. Grade: ${esc(m.grade || "")}. Prior-close context: ${esc(m.tail_proxy || "")}. Buyback signal: ${esc(m.buyback_signal || "")}. <span class="desk-src">Sources: ${Object.values(D.sources || {}).map(esc).join(" · ")}. Engine <b>justhodl-auction-desk v${esc(D.version)}</b>, ran ${ago(D.generated_at)}.</span>`;
  }

  function renderReactions(D) {
    const R = D.reactions || {};
    const pred = R.price_lineage_verified === true ? R.prediction || [] : [];
    const f = v => v == null ? "—" : (v > 0 ? "+" : "") + v.toFixed(2) + "%";
    const cell = h => h && h.median != null ? `<span class="mv ${h.median > 0.05 ? "pos" : h.median < -0.05 ? "neg" : "flat"}">${f(h.median)}</span><div class="rx-hit">${h.hit}% up · n ${h.n}</div>` : "<span class=\"flat\">—</span>";
    const cls = (R.today_classes || []).map(c => (R.class_labels || {})[c] || c).join(" + ");
    $("rx-meta").textContent = cls ? `today = ${cls}` : "";
    $("rx-pred").innerHTML = pred.length ? pred.map(p => `<tr><td class="tk" title="${esc(p.asset_class)}">${esc(p.name)} <span class="rx-cls">${esc(p.symbol)}</span></td><td class="rx-basis" style="white-space:normal;max-width:180px">${esc(p.basis_label)}<br>${p.n} days since bank start</td><td class="r">${cell(p.same_day)}</td><td class="r">${cell(p.d1)}</td><td class="r">${cell(p.d5)}</td><td class="r">${cell(p.d20)}</td><td class="r"><span class="flat">Descriptive only</span></td></tr>`).join("")
      : `<tr><td colspan="7" class="flat">${esc(R.price_lineage_verified !== true ? "Historical reaction display awaits verified price lineage and source replay." : R.note || "No eligible historical sample.")}</td></tr>`;
    $("rx-note").textContent = "Historical price rows remain in the downloadable packet for investigation. Display requires original-response lineage. Same-day is prior-close to auction-day close, not the price response after an auction announcement. Conditional samples overlap and do not grant forecast confidence or trade authority.";
    const board = R.price_lineage_verified === true ? R.scoreboard || [] : [];
    const mv = (m, k) => m && m[k] != null ? `<span class="mv ${m[k] > 0.05 ? "pos" : m[k] < -0.05 ? "neg" : "flat"}">${f(m[k])}${(m.partial || []).includes(k) ? " <i>so far</i>" : ""}</span>` : `<span class="flat">${m && m.pending ? "pending" : "—"}</span>`;
    const pair = (moves, sym) => { const m = moves[sym]; return `<td class="r">${mv(m, "same_day")}<div class="rx-hit">next ${mv(m, "d1")}</div></td>`; };
    $("rx-board").innerHTML = board.map(b => `<tr><td class="tk">${fmtDate(b.date)}</td><td style="white-space:normal;min-width:200px">${esc((b.labels || []).join(" + "))}${b.grades && b.grades.length ? ` <span class="rx-cls">grades ${b.grades.join("")}</span>` : ""}${b.buyback_accepted ? ` <span class="rx-cls">buyback ${bn(b.buyback_accepted)}</span>` : ""}<div class="rx-cls">${esc(b.headline || "")}</div></td>${["SPY","QQQ","TLT","HYG","BTC-USD","GLD","SLV","VNQ"].map(s => pair(b.moves || {}, s)).join("")}</tr>`).join("") || `<tr><td colspan="10" class="flat">${R.price_lineage_verified !== true ? "Historical price rows withheld pending original-response verification." : "No eligible historical sample."}</td></tr>`;
  }

  function findAuction(D, key) {
    const [cusip, date] = String(key).split("|");
    return (D.auctions || []).find(a => a.cusip === cusip && a.auction_date === date) || ((D.today || {}).auctions || []).find(a => a.cusip === cusip && a.auction_date === date);
  }
  function openGradeExplainer(a) {
    const zsig = v => v == null ? "—" : (v > 0 ? "+" : "") + v.toFixed(2) + "σ";
    const parts = a.score_parts || [];
    const grades = ["F", "D", "C", "B", "A"];
    $("gx-title").innerHTML = `<span class="op-grade ${a.grade}" style="cursor:default">${esc(a.grade)}</span> ${esc(a.term)} ${esc(securityLabel(a))} · ${esc(a.auction_date)}`;
    $("gx-sub").textContent = `${bn(a.total_accepted)} accepted · demand score ${a.demand_score == null ? "n/a" : (a.demand_score > 0 ? "+" : "") + a.demand_score.toFixed(2)} · compared with the last ${(a.trailing12 || {}).n || 0} ${a.term} ${securityLabel(a).toLowerCase()} auctions`;
    const table = parts.length ? `<table><thead><tr><th>What we measured</th><th class="r">vs usual (σ)</th><th class="r">weight</th><th class="r">points</th><th>why it counts</th></tr></thead><tbody>${parts.map(p => `<tr><td>${esc(p.metric)}</td><td class="r">${zsig(p.z)}</td><td class="r">${p.weight > 0 ? "+" : ""}${p.weight}</td><td class="r ${p.contribution > 0 ? "pos" : p.contribution < 0 ? "neg" : ""}">${p.contribution == null ? "—" : (p.contribution > 0 ? "+" : "") + p.contribution.toFixed(2)}</td><td style="white-space:normal">${esc(p.why)}</td></tr>`).join("")}</tbody></table>` : "<p>No trailing history for this tenor yet, so no grade.</p>";
    const scale = `<div class="scale">${grades.map(g => `<span class="${g === a.grade ? "on" : ""}">${g}${g === "A" ? " ≥ +1.0" : g === "B" ? " ≥ +0.4" : g === "C" ? " ≥ −0.4" : g === "D" ? " ≥ −1.0" : " < −1.0"}</span>`).join("")}</div>`;
    const plain = `<ul>${(a.explain || []).map(l => `<li><b>${esc(l.metric)}</b> — ${esc(l.text)}</li>`).join("")}</ul>`;
    $("gx-body").innerHTML = `<p style="font-size:12.5px;color:var(--fg-2);line-height:1.55">σ ("sigma") says how unusual today's number is against the last 12 auctions of this exact tenor: 0 is normal, +1 is clearly stronger than usual, −1 clearly weaker. The points are averaged into the demand score, and the score maps to the grade.</p>${table}${scale}<h4 style="font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--fg-3);margin:6px 0">The numbers in plain English</h4>${plain}`;
    $("gx-overlay").classList.add("open");
    $("gx-close").focus();
  }
  function wireExplainer(D) {
    document.querySelectorAll("[data-gx]").forEach(el => el.addEventListener("click", e => { e.stopPropagation(); const a = findAuction(D, el.dataset.gx); if (a) openGradeExplainer(a); }));
  }
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
    const ov = $("gx-overlay");
    $("gx-close").addEventListener("click", () => ov.classList.remove("open"));
    ov.addEventListener("click", e => { if (e.target === ov) ov.classList.remove("open"); });
    document.addEventListener("keydown", e => { if (e.key === "Escape" && ov.classList.contains("open")) ov.classList.remove("open"); });
  });

  async function load() {
    let D = null;
    for (const u of [FEED, FEED_S3]) {
      try { const r = await fetch(u + "?t=" + Math.floor(Date.now() / 60000)); if (r.ok) { D = await r.json(); break; } } catch (e) {}
    }
    if (!D) { $("desk-headline").textContent = "Auction desk feed unavailable — the engine has not published yet."; return; }
    window.__AUCTION_DESK = D;
    renderBanner(D); renderReactions(D); renderOps(D); renderBuybacks(D); renderCalendar(D); renderDays(D); renderTape(D); renderTenors(D);
    wireExplainer(D);
  }
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", load);
})();
</script>

<!-- ─────────── PLAIN-ENGLISH MARKET IMPACT ─────────── -->
<section class="box">
  <div class="head">
    <h3>What these measurements can support</h3>
    <span class="right">plain-English synthesis</span>

<!-- ─────────── METHODOLOGY ─────────── -->
<section class="box">
  <div class="head">
    <h3>📐 Methodology</h3>
    <span class="right">how the score is computed</span>
  </div>
  <div class="body" style="font-size:12px; color:var(--fg-2); line-height:1.7">
    <p>Measurements above come from the reported Treasury auction and buyback sources. Compare observation dates separately from engine publication time; a polling schedule is not a guaranteed publication latency.</p>
    <p>The six detector patterns are legacy descriptive heuristics. Selected crisis examples do not establish calibration, prospective accuracy, causal market impact or portfolio sizing. AAH denotes marginal-bid proration; it is not dealer absorption or a when-issued tail.</p>
    <p>The composite summarizes those heuristics. Historical conditional estimates require retained source data and a reproducible evaluation before display. No claim of a live historical warning or absence of backtest bias is made here.</p>
    <p>Security kind, quote basis and reopening status must agree for comparisons. Buyback accepted par and settlement cash are separate quantities. <a href="/data/auction-desk.json">Inspect the current measurement packet</a>.</p>
  </div>
</section>


<div class="footer">
  Treasury auction tape · inspect source observation and publication dates above ·
  source: <a href="https://api.fiscaldata.treasury.gov" target="_blank">api.fiscaldata.treasury.gov</a> ·
  <a href="/auction-crisis.html">crisis detector page →</a>

<script>
// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// STATIC KNOWLEDGE BASE — historical anchors & BTC regime map
// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

// Unsupported static datasets retained only in docs/audit; never displayed as research evidence.
const S3_URL = "/data/auction-crisis.json";
const escapeAuction=s=>String(s==null?"":s).replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;", "'":"&#39;"}[c]));
let liveData = null;

function fmtNum(v, dp=2) {
  if (v == null || isNaN(v)) return "—";
  return Number(v).toFixed(dp);
}
function fmtPct(v, dp=1) {
  if (v == null || isNaN(v)) return "—";
  return Number(v).toFixed(dp) + "%";
}
function fmtMaybeMoney(v) {
  if (v == null || isNaN(v)) return "—";
  if (v > 1000) return "$" + (v/1000).toFixed(1) + "K";
  return "$" + v.toLocaleString();
}
function regimeClass(r) {
  if (!r) return "calm";
  const m = { "CALM":"calm", "WATCH":"watch", "ELEVATED":"watch",
              "ACUTE_STRESS":"acute", "CRISIS":"crisis" };
  return m[r] || "calm";
}

// Hero / score ring
function renderHero(d) {
  for (const id of ["m_auctions14d","m_issuance","m_fedfunds","m_latest"]) document.getElementById(id).textContent = "—";
  document.getElementById("m_issuance").classList.remove("up", "dn");
  document.getElementById("scoreRing").style.background = "var(--bg-elev)";
  document.getElementById("scoreNum").style.color = "var(--fg-3)";
  document.getElementById("scoreRegime").style.color = "var(--fg-3)";
  const s = typeof d.composite_score === "number" && Number.isFinite(d.composite_score) && d.composite_score>=0 && d.composite_score<=100 ? d.composite_score : null;
  if(s==null){document.getElementById("scoreNum").textContent="—";document.getElementById("scoreRegime").textContent="UNAVAILABLE";document.getElementById("interpretText").textContent="No valid auction concern score is available.";return;}
  document.getElementById("scoreNum").textContent = s.toFixed(1);
  // Color based on score
  let color, regimeText;
  if (s < 30)      { color = "var(--green)"; regimeText = "🟢 CALM"; }
  else if (s < 50) { color = "var(--amber)"; regimeText = "🟡 WATCH"; }
  else if (s < 75) { color = "var(--orange)"; regimeText = "🟠 ELEVATED"; }
  else             { color = "var(--red)"; regimeText = "🔴 ACUTE STRESS"; }
  document.getElementById("scoreNum").style.color = color;
  document.getElementById("scoreRegime").textContent = regimeText;
  document.getElementById("scoreRegime").style.color = color;
  // Conic gradient progress
  const pct = Math.min(100, s);
  document.getElementById("scoreRing").style.background =
    `conic-gradient(${color} 0%, ${color} ${pct}%, var(--bg-elev) ${pct}%, var(--bg-elev) 100%)`;
  // Interpretation
  document.getElementById("interpretText").textContent = "Legacy descriptive concern score. It is not a calibrated event probability or allocation instruction.";
  // Meta
  document.getElementById("m_auctions14d").textContent = d.n_recent_auctions_14d ?? "—";
  const iss = d.issuance_anomaly?.pct_above_baseline;
  if (typeof iss === 'number' && Number.isFinite(iss)) {
    const el = document.getElementById("m_issuance");
    el.textContent = (iss >= 0 ? "+" : "") + iss.toFixed(1) + "%";
    const cls = iss < 0 ? "up" : (iss > 10 ? "dn" : "");
    if (cls) el.classList.add(cls);
  }
  document.getElementById("m_fedfunds").textContent = typeof d.fed_funds_rate === "number" && Number.isFinite(d.fed_funds_rate) ? d.fed_funds_rate.toFixed(2) + "%" : "—";
  const fr = d.freshness || {};
  if (fr.latest_auction_date) {
    document.getElementById("m_latest").textContent =
      fr.latest_auction_date + (fr.hours_since_latest_auction != null
        ? ` (${Math.round(fr.hours_since_latest_auction)}h ago)` : "");
  }
}

// Decisive call
function renderCall(d) {
  const stamp=Date.parse(d.generated_at);
  const current=Number.isFinite(stamp) && stamp<=Date.now()+300000 && Date.now()-stamp<48*3600000;
  const score=current && typeof d.composite_score==='number' && Number.isFinite(d.composite_score) ? d.composite_score : null;
  document.getElementById("callVerdict").textContent=score==null ? "Auction assessment unavailable" : "Descriptive auction concern score: "+score.toFixed(1)+"/100";
  document.getElementById("callReasoning").textContent="This heuristic summarizes auction measurements. It has no calibrated event probability or validated portfolio allocation rule.";
  document.getElementById("callStops").textContent="Read bid-to-cover, primary-dealer awards, indirect participation and AAH separately. Indirect participation is not foreign demand; AAH is not dealer absorption or a when-issued yield tail.";
}

// 6 indicator cards
function renderIndicators(d) {
  // Build from the 6 patterns. Read state from latest auction's indicator_scores or composite.
  const recent = d.recent_auctions || [];
  // For each pattern, find max score across recent
  const patterns = [
    { key:"zero_rate_floor", name:"Zero-rate floor",
      desc:"Descriptive near-zero-rate heuristic; requires both the policy rate and applicable bill rate observations.",
      threshold:"FF ≤ 0.5% AND high_rate ≤ 0.10%" },
    { key:"btc_extreme", name:"BTC extreme",
      desc:"High bill bid-to-cover is a participation observation. This threshold alone cannot establish a panic or a funding crisis.",
      threshold:"BTC ≥ 4.0 on bills" },
    { key:"tail_stress", name:"Allotted-at-high proration",
      desc:"Legacy heuristic based on marginal-bid allotment. This is not a yield tail or dealer absorption.",
      threshold:"Tenor-specific AAH heuristic; uncalibrated" },
    { key:"pd_absorption", name:"PD absorption",
      desc:"Elevated primary-dealer awards. Compare the same instrument and offering context before interpreting changes in customer participation.",
      threshold:"Primary dealer % ≥ 70%" },
    { key:"indirect_collapse", name:"Indirect collapse",
      desc:"Tracks low indirect participation, including domestic and foreign customers. It does not measure foreign demand alone.",
      threshold:"Indirect % ≤ 30%" },
    { key:"issuance_explosion", name:"Issuance explosion",
      desc:"Compares the reported issuance window with its baseline. A change in issuance alone does not establish fiscal stress or a net liquidity impulse.",
      threshold:"4w / 12m baseline ≥ 1.20" },
  ];
  const root = document.getElementById("indicators");
  root.innerHTML = patterns.map(p => {
    let maxScore = null, status = "unknown", count = 0, observed = 0;
    for (const a of recent) {
      const s = a.indicator_scores?.[p.key];
      if (typeof s === 'number' && Number.isFinite(s)) {
        observed++;
        if (maxScore == null || s > maxScore) maxScore = s;
        if (s >= 50) count++;
      }
    }
    if (p.key === "issuance_explosion") {
      const iss = d.issuance_anomaly?.pct_above_baseline;
      if(typeof iss === 'number' && Number.isFinite(iss)) status = iss >= 20 ? "firing" : iss >= 10 ? "watch" : "off";
    } else if(maxScore != null) {
      status = maxScore >= 60 ? "firing" : (maxScore >= 30 ? "watch" : "off");
    }
    const statusText = status === 'unknown' ? 'UNAVAILABLE' : status === "firing" ? "🔴 FIRING" : status === "watch" ? "⚠ WATCH" : "✓ OFF";
    const detail = status === 'unknown' ? 'No eligible observation supplied' : p.key === 'issuance_explosion' ? `${d.issuance_anomaly.pct_above_baseline.toFixed(1)}% relative to the reported baseline` : `${count} of ${observed} reported auction indicator observations above the count threshold`;
    return `<div class="ind ${status}">
      <div class="status">${statusText}</div>
      <div class="name">${p.name}</div>
      <div class="desc">${p.desc}</div>
      <div class="threshold"><strong>Threshold:</strong> ${p.threshold} · <em>${detail}</em></div>
    </div>`;
  }).join("");
}

// Last 14d tape
function renderTape(d) {
  const recent = d.recent_auctions || [];
  if (recent.length === 0) {
    document.getElementById("tapeBody").innerHTML = `<tr><td colspan="10" style="color:var(--fg-3); text-align:center; padding:20px">No recent auctions data</td></tr>`;
    return;
  }
  document.getElementById("tapeBody").innerHTML = recent.map(a => {
    const score = typeof a.composite_score === 'number' && Number.isFinite(a.composite_score) ? a.composite_score : null;
    const cls = score >= 60 ? "neg" : score >= 30 ? "" : "";
    const scoreColor = score >= 60 ? "color:var(--red)" : score >= 30 ? "color:var(--amber)" : "color:var(--fg-3)";
    return `<tr>
      <td>${escapeAuction(a.auction_date?.slice(0,10) || "—")}</td>
      <td>${escapeAuction(a.security_term || "—")}</td>
      <td>${escapeAuction(a.security_type || "—")}</td>
      <td class="r">${typeof a.high_rate === 'number' && Number.isFinite(a.high_rate) ? a.high_rate.toFixed(3) + "%" : "—"}</td>
      <td class="r"><strong>${fmtNum(a.btc, 2)}</strong></td>
      <td class="r">${fmtPct(a.indirect_pct, 1)}</td>
      <td class="r">${fmtPct(a.primary_dealer_pct, 1)}</td>
      <td class="r">${fmtPct(a.direct_pct, 1)}</td>
      <td class="r">${fmtPct(a.allocated_at_high_pct, 1)}</td>
      <td class="r" style="${scoreColor}; font-weight:600">${fmtNum(score, 1)}</td>
    </tr>`;
  }).join("");
}

// Crisis comparison
function renderAnchors(d) {
  document.getElementById("anchorBody").innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="7">Historical auction comparisons are unavailable until original auction records, instrument identities, quote bases and model versions are bound to each observation. No historical crisis score is inferred from the selected examples.</td></tr>';
}

// Bitcoin tops/bottoms
function renderBtc() {
  document.getElementById("btcTops").textContent = "Cross-asset historical estimates are withheld: the previous static episode figures did not have a reproducible sample or price trail. Auction participation alone does not identify Bitcoin tops, bottoms or expected returns.";
  for (const id of ["btcBottoms","btcBulls","btcBears"]) document.getElementById(id).parentElement.hidden = true;
}

// Forward-returns matrix
function renderForward() {
  document.getElementById("forwardMatrixBody").innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="13">Unavailable — no source-backed conditional-return dataset or independent validation is attached. The previous static percentages are not estimates of future returns.</td></tr>';
}

// Triggers
function renderTriggers(D) {
  const rows = (D?.calendar?.auctions || []).filter(a=>/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(a.auction_date || ""));
  const today=new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-CA',{timeZone:'America/New_York'});
  const selected=rows.filter(a=>a.auction_date>=today).sort((a,b)=>a.auction_date.localeCompare(b.auction_date)).slice(0,10);
  document.getElementById("triggers").innerHTML = selected.length ? selected.map(a=>`<div class="trigger-row"><div class="when">${escapeAuction(a.auction_date)}</div><div class="what">${escapeAuction(a.term)} · ${escapeAuction(a.instrument_kind || a.type || 'unverified instrument')}</div><div class="watch">Compare the published stop, bid-to-cover and bidder awards within the same security/reopening cohort. True when-issued tail requires a contemporaneous when-issued quote; no allocation follows automatically.</div></div>`).join('') : 'No current announced calendar is loaded. Consult the source-backed calendar above; there is no static-date fallback.';
}

// Plain-English market impact
function renderMarketImpact(d) {
  document.getElementById("marketImpact").textContent = "Auction participation is a market observation, not a calibrated forecast for Bitcoin, equities, credit, gold or the dollar. Indirect awards include domestic and foreign customers; AAH is marginal-bid proration, not a when-issued tail. Buyback accepted par is not settlement cash or monetary easing. No portfolio percentage, trim or defensive allocation is supported by this heuristic. Use the dated observations above alongside independently measured funding, credit and portfolio risk.";
}

async function loadData() {
  try {
    const r = await fetch(S3_URL + "?t=" + Date.now());
    if(!r.ok) throw new Error("Auction source unavailable");
    const d = await r.json();
    const stamp=Date.parse(d.generated_at);
    if(d.quality?.status !== 'fresh' || !Number.isFinite(stamp) || stamp>Date.now()+300000 || Date.now()-stamp>48*3600000) {
      renderHero({});
      document.getElementById('interpretText').textContent='Current auction data unavailable; no live scores or calls.';
      document.getElementById('scoreNum').textContent='—';
      document.getElementById('scoreRegime').textContent='UNAVAILABLE';
      renderCall({});renderIndicators({});renderTape({});renderMarketImpact({});
      return;
    }
    liveData = d;
    renderHero(d);
    renderCall(d);
    renderIndicators(d);
    renderTape(d);
    renderAnchors(d);
    renderMarketImpact(d);

    // Keep the measurement summary visible until an independently validated
    // allocation model exists; narrative confidence is not a position rule.
    document.getElementById("callBanner").style.display = "";
  } catch (e) {
    console.error("Failed to load auction data", e);
    document.getElementById("interpretText").textContent = "Auction source unavailable; previous live values are withheld.";
    renderHero({});renderCall({});renderIndicators({});renderTape({});renderMarketImpact({});
  }
}

// Init
renderBtc();
renderForward();
renderTriggers();
loadData();
// Refresh every 5 minutes
setInterval(loadData, 5 * 60 * 1000);
</script>

Legacy auction rows without retained instrument flags are explicitly unverified and excluded from comparable grades. Retention is not validation. See the <a href="/signal-scorecard.html">prospective research scorecard</a> for separately registered observations.</div></section>
